verdict.rationale: Vercel's own GitHub README names choosing a template as a first-party way to get started and deploy, so the capability exists. That is the only mention, and nothing describes a template gallery, one-click deploy buttons, or starters for common use cases. Missing for 10: documentation of a template/starter catalog, evidence of one-click deploy (e.g. deploy buttons), coverage of the range of use-case starters, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy one-click templates and starters for common use cases

citations.quote: Get started by importing a project, choosing a template, or using the Vercel CLI. Then, git push to deploy.
